Name: Tamamo no Mae
Information:
**Tamamo no Mae**

Tamamo no Mae was widely considered to be the most talented among the First to Skull during the Age of Sunderance. Her martial abilities didn’t reach the level of Kyuubi or Samaru, but she was equivalent enough to adapt their styles of combat into one that focused on her true expertise: the arcane arts. She was one of the first great wizards of the reforming world, but had two major flaws: her vanity as an arcanist, and her covetous style of living. She believed that mankind existed to be toyed with by greater beings - which she included herself among - and felt they had no value outside her whims. After her ascension into a daiyokai, she would infiltrate noble families (mostly Elven) and charm their leaders, then live a life of luxury while draining their resources. When they were spent, or she was discovered, she would kill the entire noble family and move on without remorse.

**Fiendish Evolution**

Tamamo no Mae’s method of “ascension” began taking form when she was seeking a way to reach the same level of power as Vestias, whom she had a one-sided rivalry with. She investigated and deeply scrutinized the Eidomantic Web, eventually realizing that the errors in its construction are what allowed yokai to exist. Tamamo no Mae became obsessed with this weakness, and continued learning about yokai and the Realm of Shadows in an effort to use that knowledge to ironically dethrone Vestias. Eventually, yokai would consume her work, and she would perform a ritual that allowed tens of thousands of lesser yokai to merge with her body. Her will dominated theirs, and the end result was a unique daiyokai, and the beginning of the First to Consume. There are those who believe that if left unchecked, Tamamo no Mae may one day ascend to a form of divinity tied to the Realm of Shadows.

**The Sealing Stone**

Kyuubi and Springmoon sought Tamamo no Mae relentlessly, and when they finally defeated her she was sealed within a large theiste stone called the Sealing Stone of Kaiyo-Ha. It was so named for the sacred spire in Honokuni where it was stored, and watched over by the country’s native deity Seiryu no Tenki, the Dragon of the East. She would remain there until freed by Nogistune, who extorted her into both handing over the essence of her soul, and aiding in the capture of Springmoon.

**The Foxfang Spire**

Tamamo no Mae’s lair is a shadow of Kaiyo-Ha where she was bound, but located in the Realm of Shadows. After being freed from its Sealing Stone, she occupied its dark reflection as an act of ironic defiance - a common thread with Tamamo no Mae. She has turned the spire into a workshop where she continues her research on the Realm of Shadows, houses her followers and captives, as well as amasses arcane secrets. It is outfitted with dimensional corridors, yokai nests, and other horrors meant to prevent trespassing.

**Defiant Collar**

Tamamo no Mae is bound to none except Nogistune, who allowed Tamamo no Mae to remain independent and corporeal even after handing over the essence of her soul. This arrangement allowed Tamamo no Mae to continue to exist and grow, but also means that the most essential part of her being is within Nogistune, and so she is bound to do Nogistune’s bidding. She has a great distaste for her opportunistic sister, but knows that Nogistune needs only to will it to end Tamamo no Mae’s life, and so acts in her best interests.

traits.name: It’s All Mine (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description:
When Tamamo no Mae is reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, she instead resets to 100 hit points, regains her spent Legendary Reactions and spell slots, ends any effects on her causing unwanted conditions, and can use her Mythic Actions and Mythic Traits for 1 hour.

Additionally, when her Mythic Awakening triggers, she conjures a magical red silk thread that binds around the throats of up to six creatures she chooses within 60 feet, which attempts to behead them. Each target must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 (10d8) slashing damage on a failure, and the thread remains around their throat for 1 minute, or half as much on a success, and the thread vanishes from them. At the start of each of Tamamo no Mae’s subsequent turns, each creature with the thread still around their throat repeats the saving throw, taking 27 (6d8) slashing damage on a failure, or ending the effect for them on a success. Any creature who is reduced to 0 hit points by any of this damage is beheaded and dies instantly.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: Tamamo no Mae is a 17th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Intelligence. She has the following spells prepared:

notes: Tamamo no Mae will not use her 6th-level or higher spells unless her Mythic Awakening has triggered, but will use higher level spell slots before that.

traits.name: Mythic: Counter Master (1/Turn)
traits.description: As long as they aren’t incapacitated, Tamamo no Mae can cast counterspell without using their reaction (but as though they had used it).

traits.name: Mythic: Spell Reflection
traits.description: When Tamamo no Mae succeeds a saving throw against a spell that targets only her, she is entirely unaffected by that spell. She can then target another creature with that spell’s effects, as though it was originating from her, using the same spell save DC and effects that targeted her.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Tamamo no Mae makes two weapon attacks, either of which it can replace with using Tragic Arrowfall or casting a spell with a casting time of 1 action using their Spellcasting trait. They can only replace an attack with each once per Multiattack.

actions.name: Arcane Blade
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Mythic: Tragic Arrowfall
actions.description: Tamamo no Mae conjures a volley of arcane spears, arrows, and bolts, and unleashes them as a Ranged Spell Attack: +13 to hit, range 60 ft., six targets. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) damage. The damage can be acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder (Tamamo chooses for each target). The same creature can be targeted up to three times by these six attacks, and all of those consolidated attacks are made using a single attack roll with their damage combined.

bonus_actions.name: Change Guise
bonus_actions.description: Tamamo no Mae changes their voice and appearance to resemble another humanoid form of her choice, or back to her true form. Her statistics remain the same in any of these forms.

bonus_actions.name: Wave Slash
bonus_actions.description: Tamamo no Mae’s next attack this turn can be made at any target within 120 feet, even if that is beyond its reach.

options.name: Betrayal
options.description: Tamamo no Mae forces a creature within 60 feet to make a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, they are charmed until the start of Tamamo no Mae’s next turn, and must immediately use their reaction to move up to their movement speed toward another creature Tamamo no Mae chooses and make an attack against them.

options.name: Dark Magic (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Tamamo no Mae casts a spell of 5th level or lower using her Spellcasting trait, with a casting time of 1 action.

mythic_actions.description: The creature may use the following actions as Legendary Actions for 1 hour after using their Mythic Awakening.

options.name: Teleport
options.description: Tamamo no Mae teleports into an unoccupied space within 30 feet.

options.name: Thread Pluck (Costs 2 Actions)
options.description: Tamamo no Mae targets one creature of her choice within 60 feet, as well as any creature within that range still being affected by the silk thread from her Mythic Awakening. Each target must make a DC 18 Strength saving throw, and is restrained until the end of her next turn on a failure.
